CustomField.label: Regional Head Titles
CustomField.description:
★R9 Comma-separated markers matched against User.Title, case-insensitively and as a substring. A user whose title contains any of them is a Regional Head, and the chain ends at their approval rather than climbing past them.
Substring rather than equality because real titles carry a region: "Regional Head, EMEA" and "Regional Head of Sales" both have to match one marker. The cost is that a title like "Assistant to the Regional Head" would match too — contrived, but the reason the field is a list rather than a hard-coded string is so an org that hits it can narrow the marker instead of asking for a code change.
Leave it blank to disable early termination entirely: the chain then always climbs the full number of levels the org chart allows.
★R9 This is the one org-shaped assumption in the whole chain, and it is unverified from this repo: nothing here knows whether this org populates User.Title at all, let alone with these words. If it keeps that fact somewhere else — a role, a permission set, a public group — this field is the wrong mechanism and ApprovalChainService.isRegionalHead is the one method to change.
